comment: Generated by scripts/emc.py from mods/<port>/emc/policy.json. Explicit values for uncraftable mystcraft items and conversions for machine steps ProjectE cannot see; the FAKE|no_emc conversion never resolves, so excluded items get no EMC. Everything else is derived from recipes by ProjectE.

mystcraft_ink_vial_black_dye.comment: The special ink vial recipe takes two black dyes, a water bucket (returned empty) and a glass bottle; its water-bottle form is the same bottle filled with water.

mystcraft_ink_vial_ink_sac.comment: The ink vial recipe also accepts ink sacs in place of black dye.

mystcraft_black_ink_bucket.comment: A bucket of ink holds the same 1000 mB as a vial and drains into the ink mixer or writing desk the same way; it has no recipe, so it is worth a bucket plus a vial's ink.

mystcraft_blank_page.comment: Paper placed in the book binder comes back out as a blank page, so a page is worth exactly one paper; symbols live in NBT, which transmutation does not copy.

mystcraft_linking_panel.comment: The ink mixer consumes a full basin of ink (one vial, returning its bottle) and one paper per linking panel.

mystcraft_unlinked_link_book.comment: The special linking book recipe binds one linking panel with one leather.

mystcraft_booster.comment: Opening a booster pack yields a folder holding sixteen generated pages; it is otherwise bought for 20 emeralds or found as loot.
